title: STR Investment in NC High Country: Honest Analysis
excerpt: The High Country's mountain charm and four-season appeal make it one of the most talked-about STR markets in North Carolina — but the numbers don't always tell the story you expect. Andrew Plyler, a Boone-based REALTOR® with deep roots in the region, gives you the honest breakdown before you buy.
